claims.text: The hotel is at 5 Rue de la Paix, 75002 Paris.

findings.quote: 5 Rue de la Paix, 75002 Paris, France

claims.text: Place Vendome and the Opera Garnier are steps from the hotel.

findings.quote: Place Vendôme and Opéra Garnier are just steps away.

claims.text: SEOK serves Korean cuisine inspired by the traditions and hospitality of Seoul.

findings.quote: SEOK offers authentic and generous Korean cuisine inspired by the traditions and hospitality of Seoul.

claims.text: PUR', led by chef Jean-Francois Rouquette, offers contemporary French cuisine with an exclusive Chef's Table experience.

findings.quote: Michelin-starred PUR' – Jean-François Rouquette invites guests to discover contemporary French cuisine, enhanced by the exclusive Chef's Table experience.
findings.note: chef, cuisine and Chef's Table all stated

claims.text: The spa has a jetted tub, a sauna, a steam room and treatment rooms including one for couples.

findings.quote: Nestled beside the inviting jetted tub, the cozy relaxation lounge is surrounded by a sauna, a steam room and 4 exquisite treatment rooms (including one duo).
findings.note: jetted tub, sauna, steam room, duo treatment room

claims.text: All rooms were updated in 2017 by American designer Ed Tuttle in a warm neutral and gold palette.

findings.quote: All rooms, including mine on the sixth floor (639), were updated in 2017 by American designer Ed Tuttle in a warm neutral and gold palette.

claims.text: Deluxe rooms have limestone bathrooms with a deep soaking tub and a separate rainfall shower.

findings.quote: The elegant limestone bathroom features a deep soaking tub and separate rainfall shower.

claims.text: Perfumer Christophe Laudamiel created the hotel's signature scent.

findings.quote: Christophe Laudamiel, a respected nose who developed scents for Ralph Lauren and Clinique, among others.
Here, he created both the signature olfactive scent for the entirety of the hotel spaces

claims.text: L'Appartement is a private apartment with a view over the roofs of Paris.

findings.quote: Our private apartment, and contemporary designed rooms and suites are intimate and welcoming spaces.
It’s artfully designed, offers five-star service and features a view over the roofs of Paris.
findings.note: view over the roofs of Paris

claims.text: Cafe Jeanne serves an all-day menu at the bar, by the fireplace or on the terrace.

findings.quote: Whether installed at the bar counter, in the restaurant seats, near the fireplace or on the terrace, a unique menu made up of gastronomic essentials is offered all day long until late night.
findings.note: all-day menu at bar, fireplace, terrace

claims.text: Opera metro station, served by lines 3, 7 and 8, is nearby.

findings.quote: Metro lines 3, 7 and 8 at Opéra Metro Station provide access to the Louvre, Champ de Mars, Notre-Dame Cathedral and more.
findings.note: listed under getting around from the hotel

claims.text: The hotel has nearly 700 square meters of meeting and event space.

findings.quote: With nearly 700 square meters (7,500 square feet) of customizable space

claims.text: Restaurant PUR' was redesigned by artist-architect Hugo Toro in fall 2024.

findings.quote: After all those years, the restaurant finally got the design refresh it deserved in fall 2024.
blending the visionary designs of artist-architect Hugo Toro with the culinary brilliance of Michelin-starred Chef Jean-François Rouquette

claims.text: The spa partners exclusively with the La Mer cosmetics brand.

findings.quote: The hotel exclusively partners with the prestigious La Mer cosmetics brand.

claims.text: Hairstylist John Nollet runs a hair salon in Suite 101 of the hotel.

findings.quote: John Nollet offers an exceptional range of exclusive cutting and care protocols in his Suite 101.

claims.text: Sixth-floor rooms have balconies with views of Parisian rooftops and Place Vendome.

findings.quote: The sixth and top floor benefits from unobstructed views of Parisian rooftops and even the Place Vendôme from the room's balconies.

claims.text: La Terrasse du Park is a sunlit terrace in the heart of the hotel, sheltered by historic facades.

findings.quote: Located in the heart of the hotel, sheltered by historic facades, this charming, sunlit terrace is the perfect spot to enjoy springtime lunches and lively dinners.

claims.text: Pets are welcome for a daily fee, but not in Restaurant PUR' or the spa.

findings.quote: There is a daily fee of €50 per pet for pets under 10 kilograms and a €100 daily fee for pets over 10 kilograms.
Pets are not allowed at Restaurant PUR' - Jean-François Rouquette and our Spa.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes ultra-luxury pricing that reflects the hotel's premium positioning.
WhataHotel notes the intimate boutique size may limit amenity variety.
